hook: Legal sent the same 80-page filing 14 times, and paid for it 14 times.
body:
Meridian is $840k over budget. Each query bills 40k fresh input tokens: 560k tokens per case.

You reorder the prompt so the filing comes first, marked cache_control: ephemeral. Query 1 writes the prefix to the cache; queries 2 to 14 read it at a fraction of the price.

The takeaway: put the stable content first and cache it. Token-lifecycle cost questions like this are core to the Claude Certified Architect – Professional (CCAR-P).
